page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.13xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server within the ecs.g6 instance family. Built on KVM hypervisor architecture, it provides 52 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. System memory capacity total is 192.0 GB, yielding a balanced ratio of approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server instance does not include local disk storage or hardware GPU acceleration, requiring data persistence to be handled via external block storage solution integration. Network connectivity delivers a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps. The balance between CPU core count and memory volume offers reliable qualitative cost efficiency for scaled enterprise backend environments, middle-tier microservices, container management nodes, and general business logic processing.
